description: This file implements a utility monitor module in C, including functions for initializing, starting, stopping, updating, and debugging monitor objects, as well as handling notifications and timers.

classes.name: T_Monitor
classes.description: Structure representing a monitor object with properties for managing timers, state, and callbacks.

methods.name: wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification
methods.description: Sends an update notification with a given event object, name, and variant data.

methods.name: timeHandler
methods.description: Timer callback that invokes the user-defined callback function.

methods.name: startMonitor
methods.description: Starts the monitor timer with the configured interval.

methods.name: wld_mon_updateEnabled
methods.description: Updates the monitor's running state based on enabled and active flags.

methods.name: wld_mon_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the monitor and updates its running status.

methods.name: wld_mon_setInterval_pwf
methods.description: Updates the monitor's interval and adjusts the timer if running.

methods.name: s_objDelete
methods.description: Handles object deletion callback, clears object reference.

methods.name: wld_mon_initMon
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with parameters, timer, and callback.

methods.name: wld_mon_destroyMon
methods.description: Destroys a monitor object, cleans up resources.

methods.name: wld_mon_writeActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the monitor and updates its enabled status.

methods.name: wld_mon_debug
methods.description: Populates a map with the current state of the monitor for debugging.
